citation: Phobius via EBI REST (this work); Kall et al. 2004 method, PMID 15111065
claim_tested: LIH1 has no N-terminal signal peptide, signal anchor or TM helix
key_finding: LIH1 P47145: TM 0, SP none, topology 'o'. Same tool called SP in 12/12 secretory controls and reproduced 7/10 annotated cleavage sites exactly; called TM in Atg15 (i12-34o) and in the K. marxianus orthologue (i21-42o)
context: Sequence only; fungal Lipase_3 family panel of 16 proteins
confidence_and_limitations: High. Limitation: prediction, not measurement; cannot exclude unconventional secretion

claim_tested: LIH1 lacks the hydrophobic N-terminal h-region of secreted family members
key_finding: h-region score 1.273 vs Youden cutoff 1.818 (ROC-AUC 0.969 on 35 secreted vs 64 cytosolic yeast proteins); below the minimum of all 35 secreted relatives (1.500); max 19-residue KD window 1.358, located at residue 175 inside the catalytic core
context: UniProt reviewed fungal PF01764 panel plus S. cerevisiae cytosolic negatives
confidence_and_limitations: High, concordant with Phobius. Limitation: in-house scoring, benchmarked but not a published tool

claim_tested: The LIH1 N-terminus is folded into the hydrolase core, so there is nothing to cleave
key_finding: LIH1 residues 1-25: pLDDT 77.9, N-terminal/core contact ratio 0.284, 4/25 residues with no core contact. Five signal-bearing controls: pLDDT 41-56, ratio 0.000-0.119, 16-25/25 residues with no core contact
context: AlphaFold models; controls include two ECO:0000269 signal peptides
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate-high. Limitation: AlphaFold is trained on mature structures and may under-model true signal peptides, which is exactly the signature used here

claim_tested: The published extracellular 'YJR107W' lipase is the K. marxianus orthologue, not S. cerevisiae LIH1
key_finding: 59.2% identity over 255 residues; LIH1 32-286 aligns to K. marxianus 88-342, so the orthologue has a ~56-residue N-terminal extension. Phobius calls that extension a TM helix (21-42); h-region 2.845 vs LIH1 1.273. PMID 31758565 reports a 25-residue signal peptide and 44.53 kDa for KmYJR107Wp, inconsistent with LIH1 (328 aa, 37.2 kDa)
context: K. marxianus L-2029 vs S. cerevisiae S288C
confidence_and_limitations: High for the orthology offset. Limitation: identity-scoring SW underestimates remote homology

claim_tested: S. cerevisiae has no extracellular lipase activity of its own
key_finding: BY4742 is used as the expression host precisely because it is a 'yeast strain without extracellular lipase activity'; the K. marxianus YJR107W gene conferred 0.397 U/mg
context: S. cerevisiae BY4742, galactose induction, flask culture
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate. Limitation: stated as a host property, not a dedicated LIH1 deletion/secretion experiment; LIH1 may be poorly expressed under those conditions

claim_tested: LIH1 is an SRP substrate and therefore ER-targeted
key_finding: LIH1 mRNA recovered in Srp54-TAP ribosome-nascent-chain complexes. The same study reports partial overlap between SRP and the general chaperone NAC substrate sets
context: S. cerevisiae, Srp54-TAP RNC immunoaffinity, microarray readout
confidence_and_limitations: Low as a targeting call. mRNA association, not protein localization; no hydrophobic element exists in LIH1 for SRP to recognise

citation: PMID 23409723 (Freeberg et al. 2013); PMID 18523582 (Saint-Georges et al. 2008)
claim_tested: LIH1 mRNA is a Puf3 target, implying mitochondrial-surface translation
key_finding: Puf3 bound the LIH1 3'UTR. Puf3 class I mRNAs (256 genes) carry a 3'UTR Puf3 motif and localize to the mitochondrial periphery
confidence_and_limitations: Low-moderate. Consistent with an intracellular location; does not support secretion

claim_tested: No experimental localization or activity data exist for LIH1
key_finding: CC and BP GO terms are GO:0005575 and GO:0008150 with ND evidence (last reviewed 2003-02-13); the only MF is triacylglycerol lipase activity, IEA. Zero experimental GO annotations. UniProt EC 3.1.1.3 and FUNCTION are ECO:0000305, gene name ECO:0000303, both from PMID 26580812
confidence_and_limitations: High for the database state itself

citation: PMID 23509072 (Breker et al. 2013), via PMID 29467336 (Ho et al. 2018)
claim_tested: LIH1 protein is expressed and was imaged as a GFP fusion
key_finding: 1215 molecules/cell in SD, 1260 after 15 h nitrogen starvation, confocal microscopy. No localization call for LIH1 is recorded at SGD
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate for expression. The localization call from this screen was not retrievable programmatically and needs manual lookup in LOQATE
